commūniō

commūniō, commūniōnis f.

noun, third declension

Holy Communion

In this lexicon

  • communion

    the recommended word · late Latin · Aug. Ep. 54.6 (Lewis & Short: sānctī altāris)

Examples

  • Calix benedictiōnis, cui benedīcimus, nōnne commūnicātiō sanguinis Chrīstī est? et pānis quem frangimus, nōnne participātiō corporis Dominī est?

    The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a sharing in the blood of Christ? And the bread that we break, is it not a sharing in the body of the Lord?Vulg. 1 Cor. 10.16
